results.content:
## What Is GPT-6.2?

GPT-6.2 is a new generation of OpenAI reasoning models introduced on November 17, 2026. It includes two models with different performance and cost priorities.

 GPT-6.2 Astra: OpenAI’s frontier model for complex reasoning, coding, scientific work, and professional tasks.
 GPT-6.2 Sol: A versatile and more cost-efficient model for everyday work, coding, and agent workflows. [...] GPT-6.2 is OpenAI’s latest model generation for professional work, coding, and AI-powered workflows. It introduces two models: GPT-6.2 Astra, designed for complex projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, built for everyday work and agentic tasks.

Both models improve task performance and token efficiency compared with their predecessors. GPT-6.2 Astra costs $8 per million input tokens, while GPT-6.2 Sol starts at $2. Below is a closer look at their differences, capabilities, pricing, and availability. [...] | Feature | GPT-6.2 Astra | GPT-6.2 Sol |
 --- 
| Model ID | `gpt-6.2-astra` | `gpt-6.2-sol` |
| Positioning | Frontier reasoning model | Everyday work model |
| Best for | Complex professional work, coding, science | Everyday tasks, coding, agents |
| Context window | 1.05M tokens | 1.05M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens | 128K tokens |
| Input | Text and images | Text and images |
| Output | Text | Text |
| Input price | $8 / 1M tokens | $2 / 1M tokens |

results.title: OpenAI model release dates: o3, GPT-5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna in order · Think Facility
results.content:
## Astra, Sol, Terra, Luna: which GPT is which

This is the part that confused me. In July, OpenAI stopped using plain version numbers and gave the GPT-5.6 family three names: Sol "for frontier capability", Terra "for a balance of intelligence and cost" and Luna "for efficient, high-volume workloads". Sol was the top. [...] GPT-6 kept two of those names and moved one of them. Astra is the new top, and the models page now says to use it if you're "not sure where to start". GPT-6 Sol is the middle model, there to "balance intelligence and cost", which is the job Terra had. Luna is still the cheap one. There's no GPT-6 Terra on the page at all. [...] That makes "Sol" ambiguous. GPT-5.6 Sol is last generation's flagship and GPT-6 Sol is this generation's mid-tier. They're separate models with separate IDs (`gpt-5.6-sol` and `gpt-6-sol`), so check which one a benchmark or a forum post means before you compare anything.

| Model | Role | In / out per 1M |
 --- 
| GPT-6 Astra | Flagship | $10 / $50 |
| GPT-6 Sol | Middle | $2 / $10 |
| GPT-6 Luna | Cheap, high volume | $0.10 / $0.50 |
| GPT-5.6 Sol | Last generation's top | $4 / $20 |
